scope: Selected Annex L matrix-cell and ADR decisions; this does not re-ratify Annex L as a whole.

decisions.source: The replacement XLSX labels columns as Parent and rows as Child. #83 text says P is parent and Table child; #440 errata changes WP parent/Figure child. The child-row/parent-column counterpart cells are the opposite-direction combinations and remain forbidden.
decisions.decision: Record one-way relations only: P→Table (M33 0..n; reverse AH10 forbidden) and WP→Figure (AC41 0..n; reverse AP28 forbidden). Prior prose saying #83 was 'both directions' is inaccurate: the two cell views repeat one edge, they do not authorize its inverse.

decisions.topic: Generated merge wrapper versus full Table L.2
decisions.source: Effective C3 requires exactly one Document below StructTreeRoot; D3 allows Document below Document 0..n. Current writer constructs precisely those two edge kinds when at least two PDF 2.0 Documents, including role-mapped Documents, are merged.
decisions.decision: Retain the narrow writer implementation and ADR 1474. Describe the evidence as checking C3/D3 for a generated wrapper, not implementing or validating every Table L.2 cell. Do not infer malformed-source rejection duties from these producer constraints.

decisions.source: ADR 0716 says #83 admits P→Table 'both directions' and that no code reads any Table L.2 cell. Later ADR 1474 and current wrapper.rs/write.rs implement a hand-selected Document-root/Document-child relation, not a generic matrix lookup.
decisions.decision: Treat ADR 0716 as historical errata-accounting rationale, not an accurate current implementation description. Its bidirectional paraphrase should be corrected in durable review material; if the ADR is edited later, preserve the historical status but mark that ADR 1474 implemented one bounded case. There remains no general cell-driven checker.
decisions.status: stale wording identified; no production defect

decisions.source: The grouped p.962 annotation states #336 altered the Annex L matrices, while the available replacement attachment contains only the effective combined result; no prior attachment comparison or standalone #336 cell-edit description was inspected.
decisions.decision: Keep #336 explicitly partial. Use the effective matrix for present conformance checks, but do not invent a cell delta or claim full issue disposition.
